### Confetti Overflowing
Author: Paris Renae
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/encouragement-caf-january-17-2017.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 3:12
Points:
- Small, spontaneous acts of kindness inspire others and trigger a wider ripple effect.
- Believers are already lavishly blessed through salvation and called to share that abundance.
- Showing love and generosity is the Holy Spirit working through believers, not a reward for merit.
- Believers should proactively look for opportunities to refresh and encourage those around them.

### A Prayer for Overflowing Love
Author: Lindsay Tedder
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/your-daily-prayer/your-daily-prayer-september-13.html
Passage: 1 Thessalonians 3:12
Points:
- Practicing gratitude during everyday frustrations helps cultivate an ongoing posture of prayer.
- Demonstrating genuine Christian love requires extending kindness beyond people who think or act like us.
- Believers depend on God to soften hardened hearts and produce an overflow of love.
- Living out unconditional love serves as an open testimony of Christ to the world.
